design_description: The Passyunk AC kit uses a refined sky-blue and burgundy palette, combining a classic football identity with a subtle reference to the team's local roots. The sky-blue shirt is covered front and back by a very understated tone-on-tone street-map pattern, giving the fabric depth without making the design visually busy. The map treatment makes the jersey feel connected to Passyunk and its neighborhood identity while remaining almost invisible from a distance. Deep burgundy provides the main contrast across the collar, shoulder stripes, sleeve cuffs, crest and branding. Thin lighter detailing around the trims keeps the transition into the blue clean and gives the shirt a slightly retro, tailored character. The back remains particularly clean: burgundy player name and oversized number dominate the composition, while a small local/team symbol sits beneath the rear collar. The map graphic continues behind everything rather than stopping around the personalization. The shorts stay predominantly sky blue, allowing the shirt to carry the concept, with burgundy hem trim, player number, crest and Momuto branding tying the full kit together. Overall, it is a location-driven design executed with restraint: Passyunk represented through the street-map texture, a distinctive sky-blue/burgundy colour identity, and traditional football detailing that keeps the kit elegant rather than overly graphic.
